budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-COLLECT2/L20KIT 10-21 (MU.S81.L20.KIT): predecessor gate (S81-IDXRD 7dc7fbf3b, native PASS max32) died in GPL-0305 after timing-driven repair (19,249 buffers / 5,371 long wires, slack -425 ps) + routability inflation (top-0.5% congestion 1.76): ~1 mm unregistered spans inside the kit. Structural fix, reach <= 405 um: RTL OH=2 kept relay hops on the W->E qo/so pass-through (513+276 b, 3 segments ~345 um) and RH=2 kept relay hops from the N-face rri pin flops to the landing logic; SRAM column reordered so the 8 landing macros sit at the top under the rri pins (y 475-1181; queues sq/mq bottom beside the chunk tails, iq/lm middle); rri pins pinned to x 97.2-518.4 over the SRAM column, rqo 0-86.4. Cost +2 edges a reader on the q/s chains, +2 on the response lane (static; T0 absorbs). Main outline 1036.8 x 1209.6.
